statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-13318 (GHSA-cgm6-wvp9-4g5h) is a server-side request forgery in the KubeVirt virt-api port-forward handler (pkg/virt-api/rest). That code is not part of the virt-handler binary: the shipped virt-handler binary contains no symbols from the kubevirt.io/kubevirt pkg/virt-api packages, and the import graph of the virt-handler command contains no pkg/virt-api package for KubeVirt v1.6.6, v1.7.4, v1.8.4 or v1.9.1. The upstream fix is first available in KubeVirt 1.10.0-rc.0.

CVE-2026-13318 (GHSA-cgm6-wvp9-4g5h) is in the virt-api port-forward handler (pkg/virt-api/rest/portforward.go), which dials a target address taken from VirtualMachineInstance interface status. The virt-exportproxy binary is built from ./cmd/virt-exportproxy. The Go dependency graph of that command at KubeVirt v1.6.6, v1.7.4, v1.8.4 and v1.9.1 does not include kubevirt.io/kubevirt/pkg/virt-api or any of its subpackages, and the published v1.6.6, v1.7.4, v1.8.4 and v1.9.1 binaries contain no symbols from that package, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped binary. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cgm6-wvp9-4g5h

CVE-2026-13218 (GHSA-q3jc-42cq-33fj) is in KubeVirt's virt-handler network cache (pkg/network/cache, writeToCachedFile), which writes a cache file without symlink protection. The virt-operator binary does not include that package: it is absent from the binary's Go dependency graph and no symbols from it appear in the shipped virt-operator binary. virt-handler is not part of this image. The upstream advisory lists no patched version. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q3jc-42cq-33fj

The virt-exportproxy binary is built from ./cmd/virt-exportproxy, and the Go dependency graph of that command does not include kubevirt.io/kubevirt/pkg/network/cache at the KubeVirt releases it is built from (v1.6.6, v1.7.4, v1.8.4, v1.9.1), so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped binary.

KubeVirt virt-handler's network cache writes cache files under a path rooted in the virt-launcher pod without symlink protection. A user with access to the virt-launcher container can plant a symlink at the cache file path, causing virt-handler to follow it and overwrite an arbitrary host file with JSON content and change its ownership. No fixed KubeVirt release is available: GitHub advisory GHSA-q3jc-42cq-33fj lists no patched version for kubevirt.io/kubevirt up to and including 1.10.0-rc.0. Impact remains under investigation pending an upstream fix. Red Hat CVE record: https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-13218
